charge_port.notes: Rivian: "All 2026+ Rivian vehicles have a built-in NACS charge port" (CCS1 adapter for CCS stations).

supercharger_access.notes: Rivian: 2026+ NACS port charges at Tesla Superchargers (over 21,000 sites in North America).

wheels.notes: 20 inch road configuration (CARB) plus all-terrain 20. KBB says the 2026 R1T standard wheel was 22 inch: conflicting, so the standard flag is on 22.
22 inch option. KBB: 2026 R1T standard 22 inch. Conflict: CARB 2026 lists the Dual Large Plus pack in 20 inch only, while KBB says the 2026 R1T standard was 22 inch.
